headline: IG Petrochemicals releases latest investor presentation
summary: IG Petrochemicals Limited has filed its latest investor presentation with the NSE. The document outlines the company's current operational performance, market positioning, and strategic outlook. Retail investors can review these slides to understand the company's growth trajectory and financial health.
why_it_matters: Provides updated management commentary on future business performance.

headline: IG Petrochemicals receives new credit rating
hook: New credit assessment for IG Petrochemicals
summary: IG Petrochemicals Limited has formally notified the NSE regarding the assignment of a new credit rating. The company has fulfilled its regulatory disclosure requirements by filing this update with the exchange. Further details regarding the specific rating agency and the assigned credit grade are expected to be available in the full disclosure document on the exchange website.
why_it_matters: Credit ratings influence the company's future borrowing costs and debt profile.

headline: IG Petrochemicals fixes November 13 as dividend record date
summary: IG Petrochemicals Limited has notified the stock exchanges that November 13, 2026, will serve as the record date for an upcoming dividend payout. Shareholders holding the stock as of this date will be eligible to receive the dividend. Record dates help companies determine the exact roster of beneficial owners entitled to corporate distributions. Indian retail investors holding shares in their demat accounts by this date qualify for the payment.
why_it_matters: Qualify for IGPL dividend by holding shares on record date
